execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Activity" (
  "actionType" text NOT NULL,
  "boardId" text NOT NULL,
  "cardId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "details" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Attachment" (
  "cardId" text NOT NULL,
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "fileType" text,
  "fileUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "uploadedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Board" (
  "backgroundColorOrUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "visibility" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Board_visibility_check_49087bbc" CHECK ("visibility" IN ('PRIVATE', 'WORKSPACE', 'PUBLIC'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BoardMember" (
  "boardId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "BoardMember_role_check_35f881c2" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'NORMAL', 'OBSERVER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Card" (
  "coverImageUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "dueDateReminder" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isArchived" bool NOT NULL,
  "isDueComplete" bool NOT NULL,
  "listId" text NOT NULL,
  "position" float8 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CardLabel" (
  "cardId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "labelId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CardMember" (
  "cardId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CardVote" (
  "cardId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Checklist" (
  "cardId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "position" float8 NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ChecklistItem" (
  "assignedUserId" text,
  "checklistId" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isCompleted" bool NOT NULL,
  "position" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Comment" (
  "cardId" text NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CommentMention" (
  "commentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mentionedUserId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CustomField" (
  "boardId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "CustomField_type_check_a9f06d27" CHECK ("type" IN ('TEXT', 'NUMBER', 'DATE', 'DROPDOWN', 'CHECKBOX'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CustomFieldValue" (
  "cardId" text NOT NULL,
  "customFieldId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "value" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Label" (
  "boardId" text NOT NULL,
  "color" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."List" (
  "boardId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isArchived" bool NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "position" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "fullName" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Workspace" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "visibility" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Workspace_visibility_check_60a8f38d" CHECK ("visibility" IN ('PUBLIC', 'PRIVATE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WorkspaceMember" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "joinedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'MEMBER' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "workspaceId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "WorkspaceMember_role_check_ddb31015" CHECK ("role" IN ('ADMIN', 'MEMBER'))
)
